_metadata.description: Provider execution boundaries for Ollama and OpenRouter resources.

requirements.title: Provider calls go through resource gateway commands only
requirements.description: AI Gateway must execute Ollama and OpenRouter work through their resource command surfaces. It must not own provider credentials, construct direct HTTP provider requests, or depend on localhost provider URLs.

validation.notes: Validates provider execution uses controlled resource commands and keeps prompt text out of argv and evidence.
Exercise a route from UI/API and assert evidence identifies a resource gateway path, not a direct endpoint.

requirements.title: Provider failures are normalized without hiding resource details
requirements.description: Unavailable providers, missing roles, resource command failures, policy mismatches, and timeout/cancellation outcomes must produce consistent gateway errors with enough resource evidence to debug.

validation.notes: Validates malformed resource output maps to a typed provider failure.
Validates missing resource commands map to typed unavailable smoke status.

requirements.title: Repeated provider failures open a persisted circuit breaker
requirements.description: Provider execution failures must be classified into stable failure classes (missing_binary, timeout, malformed_json, policy_error, execution_error, cancellation, unavailable) and recorded in persisted provider-health state keyed by provider, role, and request kind. Repeated failures open a circuit breaker with cooldown and half-open recovery; route preview annotates or rejects open-breaker candidates and surfaces half-open probe eligibility without executing inference; route execution skips open-breaker candidates, allows bounded half-open probes, and updates breaker state on success/failure. Provider/role isolation must hold so one provider's breaker does not suppress a healthy fallback.

validation.notes: Pure breaker transitions: threshold opening, cooldown, half-open success close, half-open failure reopen, failure classification, and repository round-trip.
Service-level: preview skips open breakers and probes half-open, execution falls back to a healthy provider, and breakers isolate by provider/role/kind.
